test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

King Solomon of Israel is said to be one of a wisest man who ruled the earth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of a wisest man**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the phrase "**of a wisest man**."
 
• When referring to one of a group, the correct construction is "**one of the** **wisest men**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**one of the wisest men**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"King Solomon of Israel is said to be one **of the wisest men** who ruled the earth."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "is said to be one"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "King Solomon of Israel"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "who ruled the earth."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
